name: get_full_system_config
description: Get the full system configuration: subsystem states (INSTEON/Z-Wave/Zigbee/Matter enabled/connected), PLM info, firmware/software versions, available upgrades, and other passive system facts (e.g. 'Node Property History Enabled'). No params. Cheap and side-effect-free -- call it freely for any question about system state/versions/subsystem status. For a not-responding/no-status-feedback complaint specifically, prefer diagnostics_not_responding/diagnostics_no_status_feedback instead -- they already check this internally as part of their investigation.
